Every grade uses the same scale (the photos share one scale: 381 px chevron width).","colours":{"navy":"#010066","silver":"#d3d6d7","red":"#d03638","cloth":"#142347"},"provenance":"traced from the Vanguard cadet chevron photos (images/ranks/C) at the requester's direction; chrome shading flattened by chroma classification","mounts":[{"uniform":"Class A / old-style / mess-less service coat lapels","rule":"metal chevrons on both coat lapels, halfway up the seam, resting on but not over it, parallel with the ground; Airman Basic wears none (4.1.5.2.1.4, 4.1.7.2.1.2, 4.1.9.3.5, 4.1.10.1.1.2)"},{"uniform":"Class B / blue shirt, blouse, aviator-style shirt, sweaters, jackets, topcoat: collar","rule":"both sides of the collar, 1 in from and parallel to the front of the collar, centered; Fig A5-5; Airman Basic wears none (4.1.11.1.1.1.4, 4.1.12.2.3.5, 4.2.5.1.1.5, 4.2.6.2.5, 6.1.1.4, 6.1.3.4). Not worn on the blue shirt under the service coat (4.1.6.1.5). Removed for the Corporate Service Uniform (4.2.5.1.1.5 note)."},{"uniform":"ABU / BDU / blue field uniform coat collar","rule":"metal chevrons on both sides of the collar, 1 in from and parallel to the front of the collar, centered (5.1.1.1.1.4, 5.1.2.2.6, 5.2.1.1.1.6)"},{"uniform":"OCP coat / fleeces","rule":"metal device on the 2 in dark blue square (7.1.1.2.2, 6.1.10.2.2, 6.1.14.4.2); Airman Basic wears no device and no blue material"},{"uniform":"OCP / ABU / tactical / patrol caps","rule":"NONE: cadet NCOs and Airmen wear no insignia on these caps (7.1.1.8, 6.2.11.1)"}],"rank":{"grade":"Cadet Master Sergeant","abbrev":"C/MSgt","membership":"cadet","first_sergeant":false},"grade":"rank-insignia","anchors":{"top_center":[54.435,0],"bottom_center":[54.435,150.51000000000002],"center":[54.435,75.25500000000001],"left_edge":[0,75.25500000000001],"right_edge":[108.87,75.25500000000001]},"dimensions":{"form":"metal chevron (cadet NCO / Airman), flat colour","nominal_width_in":1.0887,"height_in":1.5051,"aspect_h_over_w":1.3825}}
